title.it: Irrazionalità di √2 — Dimostrazione III (Tappeto geometrico di Tennenbaum e discesa infinita)
title.en: Irrationality of √2 — Proof III (Tennenbaum's geometric carpet and infinite descent)
title.es: Irracionalidad de √2 — Demostración III (Alfombra geométrica de Tennenbaum y descenso infinito)
title.ar: لاقياسية √2 — البرهان الثالث (برهان تيننباوم الهندسي والنزول اللانهائي)

natural.it: Se esistono interi positivi p, q > 0 con p² = 2q², per il principio del buon ordinamento di ℕ esiste una coppia con denominatore q > 0 minimo possibile. Sovrapponendo due quadrati di lato q negli angoli opposti di un quadrato di lato p, il quadrato centrale di sovrapposizione ha lato p' = 2q - p e i due quadrati scoperti hanno lato q' = p - q, fornendo una soluzione intera positiva più piccola (p')² = 2(q')² con 0 < q' < q: contraddizione.
natural.en: If positive integers p, q > 0 satisfy p² = 2q², by well-ordering of ℕ we can pick a pair with minimal q > 0. Placing two squares of side q in opposite corners of a square of side p, the central overlap square has side p' = 2q - p and the two uncovered corner squares have side q' = p - q, yielding a strictly smaller positive integer solution (p')² = 2(q')² with 0 < q' < q: contradiction.
natural.es: Si p² = 2q² con q > 0 mínimo, entonces p' = 2q - p y q' = p - q satisfacen (p')² = 2(q')² con 0 < q' < q, contradiciendo la minimalidad de q.
natural.ar: بوضع مربعين طول ضلعهما q داخل مربع طول ضلعه p نحصل على حل أصغر p' = 2q - p و q' = p - q يحقق (p')² = 2(q')² مع 0 < q' < q، مما يناقض أصغرية q.

lean.code:
-- Identità algebrica esatta della discesa di Tennenbaum verificata da ring
theorem tennenbaum_descent_identity (p q : ℤ) (h : p ^ 2 = 2 * q ^ 2) :
    (2 * q - p) ^ 2 = 2 * (p - q) ^ 2 := by
  calc (2 * q - p) ^ 2
    _ = 4 * q ^ 2 - 4 * p * q + p ^ 2 := by ring
    _ = 4 * q ^ 2 - 4 * p * q + 2 * q ^ 2 := by rw [h]
    _ = 2 * (2 * q ^ 2 - 2 * p * q + q ^ 2) := by ring
    _ = 2 * (p ^ 2 - 2 * p * q + q ^ 2) := by rw [← h]
    _ = 2 * (p - q) ^ 2 := by ring

natural.it: Poiché q > 0 e p² = 2q², si ha q² < 2q² = p² < 4q² = (2q)². Essendo p, q > 0, la monotonia del quadrato implica q < p < 2q, ossia 0 < p - q < q e 0 < 2q - p.
natural.en: Since q > 0 and p² = 2q², we have q² < 2q² = p² < 4q² = (2q)². Since p, q > 0, monotonicity of squaring gives q < p < 2q, hence 0 < p - q < q and 0 < 2q - p.
natural.es: Como q² < p² = 2q² < (2q)², se deduce que q < p < 2q y por tanto 0 < p - q < q.
natural.ar: بما أن q² < p² = 2q² < (2q)² فإن q < p < 2q ومنه 0 < p - q < q.

steps.symbolic: p, q > 0 ∧ p² = 2q²  ⇒  q < p < 2q  ⇒  0 < p - q < q

lemma tennenbaum_bounds {p q : ℤ} (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q) (h : p ^ 2 = 2 * q ^ 2) :
    0 < p - q ∧ p - q < q := by
  constructor <;> nlinarith

title.en: Algebraic identity of the overlapping square

natural.it: Poniamo p' = 2q - p e q' = p - q. Allora (p')² = (2q - p)² = 4q² - 4pq + p² = 2p² - 4pq + 2q² = 2(p - q)² = 2(q')².
natural.en: Set p' = 2q - p and q' = p - q. Then (p')² = (2q - p)² = 4q² - 4pq + p² = 2p² - 4pq + 2q² = 2(p - q)² = 2(q')².
natural.es: Definiendo p' = 2q - p y q' = p - q se cumple (p')² = 2(q')².
natural.ar: بوضع p' = 2q - p و q' = p - q تتحقق المتطابقة (p')² = 2(q')².

lean.code:
example (p q : ℤ) (h : p ^ 2 = 2 * q ^ 2) : (2 * q - p) ^ 2 = 2 * (p - q) ^ 2 :=
  tennenbaum_descent_identity p q h

title.it: Contraddizione con la minimalità in ℕ
title.es: Contradicción con la minimalidad en ℕ

natural.it: La nuova coppia (p', q') = (2q - p, p - q) soddisfa (p')² = 2(q')² con 0 < q' < q, violando la scelta di q come minimo intero positivo. Pertanto non esiste alcuna soluzione intera positiva.
natural.en: The new pair (p', q') = (2q - p, p - q) satisfies (p')² = 2(q')² with 0 < q' < q, violating the choice of q as the smallest positive denominator. Hence no positive integer solution exists.
natural.es: El par (p', q') viola la minimalidad de q > 0. Por tanto no existe solución entera positiva.
natural.ar: الزوج الجديد (p', q') يناقض كون q أصغر مقام موجب ممكن.

steps.symbolic: q = min { x ∈ ℕ₊ : ∃ y, y² = 2x² }  ∧  q' < q  ⇒  ⊥

title.it: Figura: Tappeto geometrico di Stanley Tennenbaum

caption.it: Due quadrati di lato q posti negli angoli opposti di un quadrato di lato p si sovrappongono al centro in un quadrato di lato 2q - p, lasciando scoperti due quadrati d'angolo di lato p - q.
caption.en: Two squares of side q placed in opposite corners of a square of side p overlap in a central square of side 2q - p, leaving two uncovered corner squares of side p - q.
